result.instructions: Tools for Billogram, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and what is the total remaining?"; "Show customer 1042 with its current balance."; "Create a draft invoice for customer 1042 with 3 hours of consulting at 1200 SEK each.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Billogram data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billogram_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billogram_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billogram_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. billogram_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billogram_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (Billogram calls them billograms): invoice number, customer, dates, state, totals and remaining sum. Optional filter and sort. Use an id from the reply with billogram_get_invoice. GET /billogram.

filter_type.description: How to match filter_value: exact (field), starts with (field-prefix) or contains (field-search). Needs filter_field and filter_value.

filter_field.description: Field to filter on, for example state, or nested as customer:name.

order_field.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at. Needs order_direction.

tools.name: billogram_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice with its customer, items, totals, state, dates and registered payments. GET /billogram/{id}.

id.description: Invoice id (the id field of an invoice, for example 2kAEEjE).

tools.name: billogram_list_invoice_events
tools.title: List invoice events
tools.description: List invoice events (the history of changes, such as sent, paid or reminded) as Billogram returns them. Optional filter and sort. GET /billogram_event.

filter_type.description: How to match filter_value: exact (field), starts with (field-prefix) or contains (field-search). Needs filter_field and filter_value.

filter_field.description: Field to filter on, for example state, or nested as customer:name.

order_field.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at. Needs order_direction.

tools.name: billogram_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers with number, name, organisation and VAT number, contact, addresses and payment settings. Optional filter and sort. GET /customer.

filter_type.description: How to match filter_value: exact (field), starts with (field-prefix) or contains (field-search). Needs filter_field and filter_value.

filter_field.description: Field to filter on, for example state, or nested as customer:name.

order_field.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at. Needs order_direction.

tools.name: billogram_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by customer number: contact, addresses, e-invoice details and payment settings. GET /customer/{customer_no}.

tools.name: billogram_get_customer_balance
tools.title: Get customer balance
tools.description: Fetch the balance of one customer by customer number (the amount they owe). GET /customer/{customer_no}/balance.

tools.name: billogram_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List saved items (products and services) with item number, title, price, VAT, unit and bookkeeping accounts. Optional filter and sort. GET /item.

filter_type.description: How to match filter_value: exact (field), starts with (field-prefix) or contains (field-search). Needs filter_field and filter_value.

filter_field.description: Field to filter on, for example state, or nested as customer:name.

order_field.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at. Needs order_direction.

tools.name: billogram_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Fetch one saved item by item number. GET /item/{item_no}.

item_no.description: Item number (item_no) of a saved item.

tools.name: billogram_get_settings
tools.title: Get settings
tools.description: Fetch the account settings: company details, default due days, currency and invoice defaults. GET /settings.

tools.name: billogram_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Only the fields you pass are set. Creates a new customer record each time (it is not idempotent). POST /customer.

tools.name: billogram_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: Create a saved item (product or service) for later invoices. Creates a new item each time (it is not idempotent). POST /item.

unit.description: Unit, for example pcs or hour.

item_no.description: Item number to give the item.

tools.name: billogram_create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice (a Billogram billogram) for an existing customer. The invoice is created only: this server does not send it, and sending is a separate Billogram command that is not exposed. Creates a new invoice each time (it is not idempotent). POST /billogram.

price.description: Unit price, in the invoice currency.

vat.description: VAT rate number, for example 25. Omit to use the account default.

unit.description: Unit, for example pcs or hour.

item_no.description: Item number of a saved item, if the line uses one.

invoice_date.description: Invoice date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to use Billogram's default.

due_date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to use due_days or the account default.

due_days.description: Days from the invoice date to the due date.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example SEK.
